main.description: An attestor's signed vouch for a claim in this repo. The signature pre-image injects a never-stored {$type, repository} binding — the stored record carries only sig. See docs/acp.md §Attestations.

claim.description: The exact claim version attested, pinned by content hash. If the claim is rewritten, this no longer resolves and the vouch is not in force.

attestor.description: The vouching DID. Its signing key is published in its DID document.

subject.description: The subject's DID. Retained for export self-containment; the transplant defense is the $sig repository binding.

expiresAt.description: Mandatory. Validity is a pulse: short by default, renewed by re-running diligence.

status.description: Optional revocation pointer. Absent means irrevocable until expiry.

method.description: The attestor's stated diligence, e.g. "email-challenge". Informational; verifiers weigh it as policy.

sig.description: Attestor signature over the canonical DAG-CBOR pre-image (record minus sig, plus the injected $sig binding). ES256/ES256K, low-S.

statusRef.description: Pointer into the attestor's mirrorable status artifact (Token Status List semantics).

list.description: Address of the signed status artifact. Any mirror is acceptable; the newest verifiable copy wins.

index.description: This attestation's bit position in the status list.
